title: MUFFLER, TAIL PIPE & FRAME ATTACHMENT
summary: Rear exhaust: muffler and rear exhaust pipe assemblies (LH/RH) and the tail pipes that exit through the rear bumper bezel. Each tail pipe slips over the muffler outlet (a tab on the outlet locates it) and is clamped with a U-bolt, clamp, lock washer and nut; the muffler hangs from a bracket bolted up into the frame, and the muffler's own hanger plate is bolted to that bracket with a bolt into a nut on the muffler bracket.

parts.name: PIPE - TAIL
parts.name_expanded: Tail pipe (exhaust tip through bumper bezel) (LH/RH)

parts.name: BRACKET ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Bracket assembly – muffler hanger (frame to muffler)

fastening.note: View C: tail pipe [3] slips over the muffler outlet; a tab on the outlet engages a notch in the tail pipe end. Tail pipe is centered in the bumper bezel (bezel: see UPC 1).
View A: U-bolt [2] goes over the tail pipe [3] slip joint, legs down through clamp [6]; lock washer [5] and nut [4] on each leg underneath.
View B: bolt [11] goes up from below through lock washer [10], the bracket [9] and the frame, with plain washer [8] and nut [7] on top. Note: assemble bolt only in direction shown.

View B: the muffler assembly [1] carries its own hanger plate with a nut on it (label partly hidden, '..D NUT', likely weld nut; no callout). Bolt [12] with lock washer [5] and plain washer [13] goes through the loop of bracket [9] into that nut. Inner plates must be parallel after assembly.

notes: Assemble bolt only in direction shown.
Inner plates must be parallel after asm. with no lateral distortion of loop & rivets in line fore and aft.
